item_name: Rothco US Flag / USMC Eagle, Globe and Anchor Morale Patch
item_short_desc: Show your pride with Rothco’s US Flag/USMC Eagle, Globe & Anchor Morale Patch. Featuring the iconic USMC logo alongside the American flag, this patch is crafted with durable rayon threading and a soft cotton backing for comfort. The strong nylon hook backing securely attaches to loop fields on hats, jackets, or bags, offering versatile display options. Measuring 3 3/8 inches x 2 3/8 inches, it’s the perfect size to showcase your respect for the United States Marine Corps.
